verses.original: Ταῦτα λελάληκα ὑμῖν ἵνα μὴ σκανδαλισθῆτε
verses.transliteration: Tauta lelalēka hymin hina mē skandalisthēte
verses.literal: I have told you these things so that you will not fall away

verses.original: ἀποσυναγώγους ποιήσουσιν ὑμᾶς ἀλλ’ ἔρχεται ὥρα ἵνα πᾶς ὁ ἀποκτείνας ὑμᾶς δόξῃ λατρείαν προσφέρειν τῷ Θεῷ
verses.transliteration: aposynagōgous poiēsousin hymas all’ erchetai hōra hina pas ho apokteinas hymas doxē latreian prospherein tō Theō
verses.literal: They will put you out of the synagogues In fact a time is coming when anyone who kills you will think he is offering a service to God

verses.original: καὶ ταῦτα ποιήσουσιν ὅτι οὐκ ἔγνωσαν τὸν Πατέρα οὐδὲ ἐμέ
verses.transliteration: kai tauta poiēsousin hoti ouk egnōsan ton Patera oude eme
verses.literal: They will do these things because they have not known the Father or Me

verses.original: ἀλλὰ ταῦτα λελάληκα ὑμῖν ἵνα ὅταν ἔλθῃ ἡ ὥρα αὐτῶν μνημονεύητε αὐτῶν ὅτι ἐγὼ εἶπον ὑμῖν ταῦτα δὲ ὑμῖν ἐξ ἀρχῆς οὐκ εἶπον ὅτι μεθ’ ὑμῶν ἤμην
verses.transliteration: alla tauta lelalēka hymin hina hotan elthē hē hōra autōn mnēmoneuēte autōn hoti egō eipon hymin tauta de hymin ex archēs ouk eipon hoti meth’ hymōn ēmēn
verses.literal: But I have told you these things so that when their hour comes you will remember that I told you about them I did not tell you these things from the beginning because I was with you

verses.original: Νῦν δὲ ὑπάγω πρὸς τὸν πέμψαντά με καὶ οὐδεὶς ἐξ ὑμῶν ἐρωτᾷ με Ποῦ ὑπάγεις
verses.transliteration: Nyn de hypagō pros ton pempsanta me kai oudeis ex hymōn erōta me Pou hypageis
verses.literal: Now however I am going to Him who sent Me yet none of you asks Me Where are You going

verses.original: ἀλλ’ ὅτι ταῦτα λελάληκα ὑμῖν ἡ λύπη πεπλήρωκεν ὑμῶν τὴν καρδίαν
verses.transliteration: all’ hoti tauta lelalēka hymin hē lypē peplērōken hymōn tēn kardian
verses.literal: Instead your hearts are filled with sorrow because I have told you these things

verses.original: ἀλλ’ ἐγὼ τὴν ἀλήθειαν λέγω ὑμῖν συμφέρει ὑμῖν ἵνα ἐγὼ ἀπέλθω ἐὰν γὰρ μὴ ἀπέλθω ὁ Παράκλητος οὐ μὴ ἔλθῃ πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἐὰν δὲ πορευθῶ πέμψω αὐτὸν πρὸς ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: all’ egō tēn alētheian legō hymin sympherei hymin hina egō apelthō ean gar mē apelthō ho Paraklētos ou mē elthē pros hymas ean de poreuthō pempsō auton pros hymas
verses.literal: But I tell you the truth it is for your benefit . . . that I am going away Unless . . . I go away the Advocate will not come to you but if I go I will send Him to you

verses.original: Καὶ ἐλθὼν ἐκεῖνος ἐλέγξει τὸν κόσμον περὶ ἁμαρτίας καὶ περὶ δικαιοσύνης καὶ περὶ κρίσεως
verses.transliteration: Kai elthōn ekeinos elenxei ton kosmon peri hamartias kai peri dikaiosynēs kai peri kriseōs
verses.literal: And when He comes He will convict the world in regard to sin and righteousness and judgment

verses.original: περὶ ἁμαρτίας μέν ὅτι οὐ πιστεύουσιν εἰς ἐμέ
verses.transliteration: peri hamartias men hoti ou pisteuousin eis eme
verses.literal: in regard to sin because they do not believe in Me

verses.original: περὶ δικαιοσύνης δέ ὅτι πρὸς τὸν Πατέρα ὑπάγω καὶ οὐκέτι θεωρεῖτέ με
verses.transliteration: peri dikaiosynēs de hoti pros ton Patera hypagō kai ouketi theōreite me
verses.literal: in regard to righteousness because I am going to the Father and you will no longer see . . . Me

verses.original: περὶ δὲ κρίσεως ὅτι ὁ ἄρχων τοῦ κόσμου τούτου κέκριται
verses.transliteration: peri de kriseōs hoti ho archōn tou kosmou toutou kekritai
verses.literal: and in regard to judgment because the prince of this world has been condemned

verses.original: Ἔτι πολλὰ ἔχω ὑμῖν λέγειν ἀλλ’ οὐ δύνασθε βαστάζειν ἄρτι
verses.transliteration: Eti polla echō hymin legein all’ ou dynasthe bastazein arti
verses.literal: I still have much to tell you but you cannot yet bear to hear it

verses.original: ὅταν δὲ ἔλθῃ ἐκεῖνος τὸ Πνεῦμα τῆς ἀληθείας ὁδηγήσει ὑμᾶς ἐν τῇ ἀληθείᾳ πάσῃ οὐ γὰρ λαλήσει ἀφ’ ἑαυτοῦ ἀλλ’ ὅσα ἀκούσει λαλήσει καὶ τὰ ἐρχόμενα ἀναγγελεῖ ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: hotan de elthē ekeinos to Pneuma tēs alētheias hodēgēsei hymas en tē alētheia pasē ou gar lalēsei aph’ heautou all’ hosa akousei lalēsei kai ta erchomena anangelei hymin
verses.literal: However when the Spirit of truth comes He will guide you into all truth For He will not speak on His own but He will speak what He hears and He will declare to you what is to come

verses.original: ἐκεῖνος ἐμὲ δοξάσει ὅτι ἐκ τοῦ ἐμοῦ λήμψεται καὶ ἀναγγελεῖ ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: ekeinos eme doxasei hoti ek tou emou lēmpsetai kai anangelei hymin
verses.literal: He will glorify Me by taking from what is Mine and disclosing it to you

verses.original: πάντα ὅσα ἔχει ὁ Πατὴρ ἐμά ἐστιν διὰ τοῦτο εἶπον ὅτι ἐκ τοῦ ἐμοῦ λαμβάνει καὶ ἀναγγελεῖ ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: panta hosa echei ho Patēr ema estin dia touto eipon hoti ek tou emou lambanei kai anangelei hymin
verses.literal: Everything that belongs to the Father is Mine That is why . . . I said that the Spirit will take from what is Mine and disclose it to you

verses.original: Μικρὸν καὶ οὐκέτι θεωρεῖτέ με καὶ πάλιν μικρὸν καὶ ὄψεσθέ με
verses.transliteration: Mikron kai ouketi theōreite me kai palin mikron kai opsesthe me
verses.literal: In a little while . . . you will see Me no more and then after a little while . . . you will see Me

verses.original: Εἶπαν οὖν ἐκ τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ πρὸς ἀλλήλους Τί ἐστιν τοῦτο ὃ λέγει ἡμῖν Μικρὸν καὶ οὐ θεωρεῖτέ με καὶ πάλιν μικρὸν καὶ ὄψεσθέ με καί Ὅτι ὑπάγω πρὸς τὸν Πατέρα
verses.transliteration: Eipan oun ek tōn mathētōn autou pros allēlous Ti estin touto ho legei hēmin Mikron kai ou theōreite me kai palin mikron kai opsesthe me kai Hoti hypagō pros ton Patera
verses.literal: Then some of His disciples asked . . . one another Why is - He telling us In a little while . . . you will not see Me and then after a little while . . . you will see Me and Because I am going to the Father

verses.original: ἔλεγον οὖν Τοῦτο τί ἐστιν ὃ λέγει Τὸ μικρόν οὐκ οἴδαμεν τί λαλεῖ
verses.transliteration: elegon oun Touto ti estin ho legei To mikron ouk oidamen ti lalei
verses.literal: They kept asking Why is - He saying a little while We do not understand what He is saying

verses.original: Ἔγνω ὁ Ἰησοῦς ὅτι ἤθελον αὐτὸν ἐρωτᾶν καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Περὶ τούτου ζητεῖτε μετ’ ἀλλήλων ὅτι εἶπον Μικρὸν καὶ οὐ θεωρεῖτέ με καὶ πάλιν μικρὸν καὶ ὄψεσθέ με
verses.transliteration: Egnō ho Iēsous hoti ēthelon auton erōtan kai eipen autois Peri toutou zēteite met’ allēlōn hoti eipon Mikron kai ou theōreite me kai palin mikron kai opsesthe me
verses.literal: Aware that they wanted to question Him Jesus said to them Are you asking one another why . . . I said In a little while . . . you will not see Me and then after a little while . . . you will see Me

verses.original: ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι κλαύσετε καὶ θρηνήσετε ὑμεῖς ὁ δὲ κόσμος χαρήσεται ὑμεῖς λυπηθήσεσθε ἀλλ’ ἡ λύπη ὑμῶν εἰς χαρὰν γενήσεται
verses.transliteration: amēn amēn legō hymin hoti klausete kai thrēnēsete hymeis ho de kosmos charēsetai hymeis lypēthēsesthe all’ hē lypē hymōn eis charan genēsetai
verses.literal: Truly truly I tell you you will weep and wail while the world rejoices You will grieve but your grief will turn to joy

verses.original: ἡ γυνὴ ὅταν τίκτῃ λύπην ἔχει ὅτι ἦλθεν ἡ ὥρα αὐτῆς ὅταν δὲ γεννήσῃ τὸ παιδίον οὐκέτι μνημονεύει τῆς θλίψεως διὰ τὴν χαρὰν ὅτι ἐγεννήθη ἄνθρωπος εἰς τὸν κόσμον
verses.transliteration: hē gynē hotan tiktē lypēn echei hoti ēlthen hē hōra autēs hotan de gennēsē to paidion ouketi mnēmoneuei tēs thlipseōs dia tēn charan hoti egennēthē anthrōpos eis ton kosmon
verses.literal: A woman has pain in childbirth because her time has come but when she brings forth her child she forgets . . . her anguish because of her joy that a child has been born into the world

verses.original: καὶ ὑμεῖς οὖν νῦν μὲν λύπην ἔχετε πάλιν δὲ ὄψομαι ὑμᾶς καὶ χαρήσεται ὑμῶν ἡ καρδία καὶ τὴν χαρὰν ὑμῶν οὐδεὶς αἴρει ἀφ’ ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: kai hymeis oun nyn men lypēn echete palin de opsomai hymas kai charēsetai hymōn hē kardia kai tēn charan hymōn oudeis airei aph’ hymōn
verses.literal: So also you have sorrow now but I will see you again and your hearts will rejoice and no one will take away your joy

verses.original: Καὶ ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐμὲ οὐκ ἐρωτήσετε οὐδέν ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ἄν τι αἰτήσητε τὸν Πατέρα δώσει ὑμῖν ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί μου
verses.transliteration: Kai en ekeinē tē hēmera eme ouk erōtēsete ouden amēn amēn legō hymin an ti aitēsēte ton Patera dōsei hymin en tō onomati mou
verses.literal: In that day you will no longer ask Me anything Truly truly I tell you whatever you ask the Father in My name He will give you

verses.original: ἕως ἄρτι οὐκ ᾐτήσατε οὐδὲν ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί μου αἰτεῖτε καὶ λήμψεσθε ἵνα ἡ χαρὰ ὑμῶν ᾖ πεπληρωμένη
verses.transliteration: heōs arti ouk ētēsate ouden en tō onomati mou aiteite kai lēmpsesthe hina hē chara hymōn ē peplērōmenē
verses.literal: Until now you have not asked for anything in My name Ask and you will receive so that your joy may be complete

verses.original: Ταῦτα ἐν παροιμίαις λελάληκα ὑμῖν ἔρχεται ὥρα ὅτε οὐκέτι ἐν παροιμίαις λαλήσω ὑμῖν ἀλλὰ παρρησίᾳ περὶ τοῦ Πατρὸς ἀπαγγελῶ ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: Tauta en paroimiais lelalēka hymin erchetai hōra hote ouketi en paroimiais lalēsō hymin alla parrēsia peri tou Patros apangelō hymin
verses.literal: I have spoken these things to you in figures of speech An hour is coming when I will no longer speak . . . to you this way but will tell you plainly about the Father

verses.original: ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί μου αἰτήσεσθε καὶ οὐ λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ἐγὼ ἐρωτήσω τὸν Πατέρα περὶ ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: en ekeinē tē hēmera en tō onomati mou aitēsesthe kai ou legō hymin hoti egō erōtēsō ton Patera peri hymōn
verses.literal: In that day you will ask in My name I am not saying that I will ask the Father on your behalf

verses.original: αὐτὸς γὰρ ὁ Πατὴρ φιλεῖ ὑμᾶς ὅτι ὑμεῖς ἐμὲ πεφιλήκατε καὶ πεπιστεύκατε ὅτι ἐγὼ παρὰ τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐξῆλθον
verses.transliteration: autos gar ho Patēr philei hymas hoti hymeis eme pephilēkate kai pepisteukate hoti egō para tou Theou exēlthon
verses.literal: For the Father Himself loves you because you have loved Me and have believed that I came from God

verses.original: ἐξῆλθον ἐκ τοῦ Πατρὸς καὶ ἐλήλυθα εἰς τὸν κόσμον πάλιν ἀφίημι τὸν κόσμον καὶ πορεύομαι πρὸς τὸν Πατέρα
verses.transliteration: exēlthon ek tou Patros kai elēlytha eis ton kosmon palin aphiēmi ton kosmon kai poreuomai pros ton Patera
verses.literal: I came from the Father and entered . . . the world In turn I will leave the world and go to the Father

verses.original: Λέγουσιν οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ Ἴδε νῦν ἐν παρρησίᾳ λαλεῖς καὶ παροιμίαν οὐδεμίαν λέγεις
verses.transliteration: Legousin hoi mathētai autou Ide nyn en parrēsia laleis kai paroimian oudemian legeis
verses.literal: His disciples said See now You are speaking plainly and without figures of speech

verses.original: νῦν οἴδαμεν ὅτι οἶδας πάντα καὶ οὐ χρείαν ἔχεις ἵνα τίς σε ἐρωτᾷ ἐν τούτῳ πιστεύομεν ὅτι ἀπὸ Θεοῦ ἐξῆλθες
verses.transliteration: nyn oidamen hoti oidas panta kai ou chreian echeis hina tis se erōta en toutō pisteuomen hoti apo Theou exēlthes
verses.literal: Now we understand that You know all things and that You have no need for anyone to question You Because of this we believe that You came from God

verses.original: Ἀπεκρίθη αὐτοῖς Ἰησοῦς Ἄρτι πιστεύετε
verses.transliteration: Apekrithē autois Iēsous Arti pisteuete
verses.literal: Do you finally believe Jesus replied . . .

verses.original: ἰδοὺ ἔρχεται ὥρα καὶ ἐλήλυθεν ἵνα σκορπισθῆτε ἕκαστος εἰς τὰ ἴδια κἀμὲ μόνον ἀφῆτε καὶ οὐκ εἰμὶ μόνος ὅτι ὁ Πατὴρ μετ’ ἐμοῦ ἐστιν
verses.transliteration: idou erchetai hōra kai elēlythen hina skorpisthēte hekastos eis ta idia kame monon aphēte kai ouk eimi monos hoti ho Patēr met’ emou estin
verses.literal: Look an hour is coming and has already come when you will be scattered each to his own home and you will leave Me all alone Yet I am not alone because the Father is with Me

verses.original: ταῦτα λελάληκα ὑμῖν ἵνα ἐν ἐμοὶ εἰρήνην ἔχητε ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ θλῖψιν ἔχετε ἀλλὰ θαρσεῖτε ἐγὼ νενίκηκα τὸν κόσμον
verses.transliteration: tauta lelalēka hymin hina en emoi eirēnēn echēte en tō kosmō thlipsin echete alla tharseite egō nenikēka ton kosmon
verses.literal: I have told you these things so that in Me you may have peace In the world you will have tribulation But take courage I have overcome the world
